title: Trump cancels Bedminster trip over drones

tellings.quote: Donald J Trump the next American president had to skip his trip to his Bedminster New Jersey summer home because of these New Jersey drones

plain: In 2024 Donald Trump, then the incoming president, had to skip a trip to his summer home in Bedminster, New Jersey, because of the mysterious drones being reported over New Jersey. Michels states this himself, without naming a source. He brings it up to show how seriously the sightings were being taken at the top.
